_source.citation: Broadie, M. (2008). Assessing Golfer Performance Using Golfmetrics. In Science and Golf V: Proceedings of the 2008 World Scientific Congress of Golf, pp. 253-262.
_source.note: Groups are SCORE-RANGE groups, not exact handicaps: Pro1 64-71, Pro2 72-79, Am1 70-83 (low-handicap ams), Am2 84-97 (middle), Am3 98-120 (high). ~40,000 shots, 500 rounds, 130+ golfers, 2005-2007. Values transcribed verbatim from Tables 1-4 and Eq. 2.

_bracketNote: The study population played ~standard-rated courses, so raw scores off easier-rated tees flatter the player. Bracket assignment levels each round to a standard course first: adjusted = score - tee_rating + standardCourseRating.

table1._desc: Putting, sand game and long tee shots. Pro row combines Pro1+Pro2 (64-79).

table2._desc: Short game (20-60 yds) and long game (100-150 yds).

table3._desc: Exceptional shots per 18 holes, excluding putts. Awful: shot value < -0.8; great: > +0.8.

table4._desc: Total shot value vs scratch per 18-hole round by game area. Long game = shots >100y to target; short game = <100y excl. sand; sand = <50y from sand.
